name: comp-511
title: Single Date Popover Picker
blurb: Button that opens a calendar in a popover to select a single date.
description: A labeled form control with a button trigger showing the selected date or placeholder. Clicking opens a popover with a calendar. Uses Radix Popover and React DayPicker.
use_when: You need a compact date picker that saves space by hiding the calendar until clicked.
avoid_when: When users need to see multiple months at once — popovers typically show one month.
a11y: Label is properly associated with the button. Popover is keyboard-accessible. aria-live announces selections.
